notes: `aria-controls` pointing at its panel is NOT generated. `controls` names a sibling part within the same component, and a tab's panel is a different component entirely — the schema has no way to reference across a collection.
Registers its root node with the tablist and takes its `tabIndex` from `isTabStop`. A native `<button>` is in the Tab sequence by default, so this is what takes the other tabs OUT of it.

Its disabled state reaches the DOM as `aria-disabled`, NOT the native `disabled` attribute. The collection declares `disabledItems: "focusable"`, and a natively disabled button cannot be focused by any means — the roving tabIndex and a programmatic .focus() are both ignored. The emitter derives this from the ancestor’s navigation block; the activation guard it already writes is what keeps the member from being chosen.
